title: Server-side request forgery (SSRF): get() sink (no source path found)
message: Dangerous ssrf sink get() at app/tokens.py:16 that the cross-file taint pass could NOT connect to an untrusted source (orphan sink). Still worth a look — the source may arrive via a path the summary call-graph misses (framework dispatch, dynamic call, config). Tainted data used as a request URL/host via an HTTP-client method. Verify the destination is allow-listed (no internal/metadata endpoints). Receiver is generic (an HTTP client vs. a cache/map getter) — confirm it is a network call. Confirm whether attacker-controlled data can reach it before trusting it.
